canvas_categories.order_inflow_changes: Order backlog sustains at a record ₹10,066 crore (export share 38%, domestic T&D 62%), providing strong revenue visibility for 3+ years across 765 kV transmission towers, monopoles, and EPC contracting. Executive Director Sharan Bansal confirmed management projects a 35% growth in order inflows for FY27, reinforced by securing ~₹1,000 crore in export orders in Q2 alone from North America, Europe, and Australia. Turnkey transmission EPC platform 'Evergrid India' is pre-qualified to bid for ₹15,000 crore in high-voltage TBCB transmission corridors over the next 12 months, while factory dispatches commenced for multi-gigawatt Latin American 765 kV tower supply contracts.

canvas_categories.promoter_activity: Promoters (Sajan Kumar Bansal and family) hold 71.89% equity with zero encumbrance, demonstrating strong commitment and active leadership in expanding global transmission tower and monopole fabrication footprint.
canvas_categories.demand_cycle_changes: Unprecedented global and domestic grid infrastructure investments to evacuate multi-gigawatt renewable energy capacity (India 500 GW non-fossil by 2030, US/European grid modernization) drive multi-year structural supercycle for 765 kV towers, monopoles, and high-voltage substations.
canvas_categories.raw_material_changes: Domestic HR coil and zinc prices remain stable, with 85%+ of Skipper's order contracts carrying complete price escalation pass-through clauses, fully shielding operating margins.
canvas_categories.institutional_activity: Institutional allocators and infrastructure PMS funds engaged management following the Avendus Spark Mumbai conference, noting Skipper's record ₹10,066 crore backlog, 35% inflow growth guidance, and asset-light EPC scaling through Evergrid India.
canvas_categories.government_policy_changes: Central Electricity Authority (CEA) transmission rolling plan and Ministry of Power's fast-tracked ISTS bidding mandates provide structural multi-year order inflow momentum for domestic transmission infrastructure manufacturers.
canvas_categories.sector_news: Power transmission and distribution (T&D) EPC sector is experiencing an unprecedented structural boom with global supply bottlenecks in structural steel fabrication positioning Indian manufacturers as preferred global suppliers.
canvas_categories.management_commentary: Executive Director Sharan Bansal highlighted that international market expansion (securing nearly ₹1,000 crore of export orders in Q2 across North America, Europe, and Australia) marks a major inflection point, positioning Skipper for 35% growth in annual order inflows and consolidated revenues crossing ₹5,000 crore by FY28.
canvas_categories.competitor_news: KEC International and Kalpataru Projects International are also seeing strong order books, while Skipper differentiates through full backward integration from billets to towers, superior cost structure, and specialized monopole engineering.
